title: Stormilla + Trailier Tales compat
description: Recolors some textures of the Trailier Tales mod for better compatibility with the Stormilla resource pack.
body:
This resource pack recolors some textures from the Trailier Tales mod for better compatibility with the Stormilla resource pack. Tired of certain blocks using vanilla textures and looking out of place with Stormilla? Then this Add-On is for you!
Also check out the [Stormilla + Wilder Wild compat pack](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/stormilla-+-wilder-wild-compat).

Place this pack above Fabric mods and Stormilla resource packs.

[Stormilla resource pack](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/stormilla)

[Trailier Tales mod](https://modrinth.com/mod/trailier-tales)
